tests.name: fresh staging creates no Auth accounts and leaves no demo signup function
fresh baseline refuses an existing schema
every application table has row-level security
signup ignores an administrator role in user metadata and a demo admin email
provider and facility signup create pending requests and only patient privileges
patient cannot directly grant itself a role or approve its request
patient role requests and submitted forms are isolated between accounts
patient cannot create a hospital duty or a physician profile
approved providers can create profiles but cannot verify themselves
verified hospital can post a duty; an unverified physician is blocked from ICU
qualified physician claims the final slot; second physician cannot claim it
physician still sees its assigned duty after the final slot is filled
editing a verified registration number requires verification again
qualification changes also invalidate verification; availability edits preserve it
anonymous callers cannot claim duties or call the private membership helper
family plan lookup cannot expose another patient through an RPC
submitting a coordinator application does not grant access to the patient queue
verified coordinator access requires an approved provider role
no privileged public function is executable anonymously and trigger functions are not RPCs
retired home-visit RPCs cannot bypass the canonical secured lifecycle
only service-role workers can claim or finish notification jobs
serial bounded claims exclude leased, deferred and disabled jobs
a failed finish persists backoff and does not immediately reclaim the job
an expired worker lease is replaced and a stale worker cannot finish it
a sent job is final for workers and duplicate finish cannot overwrite it
a fifth abandoned attempt becomes an operations-visible failure without a sixth send
notification jobs never turn absent, partial or failed transport into sent
failed job acknowledgement is surfaced so the persisted lease can recover
unapproved real-patient rollout and direct legacy home-visit RPCs are blocked
future home booking survives immediate offline and requires explicit named-doctor acceptance
immediate request saves complete details without emergency dispatch or automatic acceptance
wrong-role, unapproved and unverified providers cannot publish or accept home visits
unrelated patient and unassigned doctor cannot read private visit, consent, event or code data
actor-scoped idempotency and opaque recovery reject changed payload and cross-account replay
coverage, dependent authority, consent and stale quotes fail atomically
client-supplied fees cannot replace the server-reviewed quote
a real consent-write failure rolls back the appointment, reservation, offers and events together
server rejects past time, blocked date, DND and invalid occupied intervals
travel buffers protect pending capacity across home, clinic and video modes
legacy slot discovery is bounded and accounts for home-visit travel buffers
expiry releases only pending capacity and rejects acceptance despite a delayed expiry job
cancellation is version checked, recorded with reason and cannot resurrect a terminal visit
arrival is patient-issued, hashed at rest, visit bound and separate from consultation
wrong codes persist rate limits; expiry and code regeneration cannot bypass exhausted attempts
only assigned clinician can sign a saved encounter before completion; payment stays separate
cash settlement requires configured authority and exact quote; replay cannot issue duplicate receipts
unapproved settlement and unsupported payment/no-show callbacks cannot change clinical or payment state
reschedule holds preserve the accepted original until explicit acceptance and release a declined replacement
private consent is server-authored, audit events append only, and disabled notifications never claim delivery
operations access is explicitly scoped and excludes address, clinical notes, consent and OTP
disjoint overdue bookings cannot give one doctor two active home visits in either start order
late travel reserves from server time and cannot overrun a near-future commitment
revoked credentials block a new consultation while preserving documentation of care already started
the active home guard leaves generic appointments with no home status unchanged
expired replacement holds preserve the original and emit one versioned audit with notification jobs
well-formed incorrect and different-visit codes fail without consuming the correct code
five synthetic users sign in through Supabase Auth
provider/facility signup grants only patient access and preserves pending requests
a patient cannot grant itself administrator access or approve a request
submitted data persists after logout and login
another patient cannot read or overwrite the saved form
family-plan RPC respects patient isolation
a submitted coordinator application has no patient-queue privileges
unverified doctors cannot claim ICU duties or verify themselves
two simultaneous claims produce exactly one accepted final-slot assignment
filled duty remains visible to its doctor and hospital, not unrelated users
editing registration identity revokes its previous verification
anonymous requests cannot call privileged staffing or family-plan RPCs
scheduled booking persists across independent second-device sessions and explicit acceptance
unrelated users, patient acceptance and direct Data API writes cannot bypass privacy
simultaneous duplicate submissions return one ID; lost-response recovery uses another session
two independent patients racing for the same slot produce exactly one reservation
two doctors accepting the same pool request produce exactly one assigned doctor
one doctor accepting conflicting immediate requests through two sessions wins only once
cancellation-versus-acceptance race has one committed transition and no resurrection
immediate acceptance versus scheduled insertion shares one doctor capacity lock
overdue visits cannot both start travel, in either order or through concurrent doctor sessions
starting an overdue visit rechecks current time against the next confirmed commitment
delayed expiry and acceptance race cannot confirm an expired request or expire a confirmed one
failed, declined and expired rescheduling retain the original; accepted replacement releases only old capacity
travel, patient-only code, consultation, signed record and truthful cash settlement persist
visible browser UI uses the deployed API for both home-visit paths
Real-phone and Capacitor restart/resume/location permission acceptance
Closed-app notification delivery and retry with approved credentials
Online gateway signed-callback and refund integration
